The cadets of Tirupati NCC group display the medals won at the Telangana State Equestrian Championship in Hyderabad. | Photo Credit: By Arrangement
Cadets of 2(A) R&V Regiment of Tirupati NCC group delivered an impressive performance at the Telangana State Equestrian Championship, conducted by Hyderabad Polo and Riding Club in association with the Telangana Equestrian Federation, from October 16 to 18 in Hyderabad.
In the Cadet Jumping – Young Rider category, K. Thirumal clinched the gold medal, while N. Pundarikaksha secured the bronze. Murali secured fourth place with a highly commended distinction. In the Open Show Jumping category, K. Thirumal won the silver medal and N. Pundarikaksha bagged the bronze.
The achievements reflected the cadets’ dedication, discipline, courage and excellent horsemanship. Their success highlights the unit’s sustained efforts in equestrian training and its commitment to nurturing young talent. The achievement has brought pride and recognition to the unit and the NCC organisation, an official release by the NCC said.
